comment: The iOS analogue of android/app/src/main/assets/categories.json: same ids, names, order and thresholds; members are Apple's label identifiers (SNClassifySoundRequest.knownClassifications). Category score = max of member confidences. Dominant: (a) the category of the top-1 label if that label is mapped and its score >= top1_threshold; (b) else the highest category score if >= category_threshold; (c) else 'unclassified'. Category order is the tie-break priority (earlier wins). Every identifier must be one of knownClassifications; AppTests checks this on the iOS Simulator, LessNoiseKit's tests against the committed list. PROVISIONAL: members are filled from the list CI dumps.
